WO_ALREADY_VERIFIED.title: This job was already verified
WO_ALREADY_VERIFIED.body: Your work is saved as extra evidence. The office will review it if needed.

WO_ARRIVAL_PROMPT_MISMATCH.title: Are you on site?
WO_ARRIVAL_PROMPT_MISMATCH.body: The job is saved. Confirm arrival, choose 'not yet' or send a point update to the office.

WO_ASSET_RETIRED.title: Asset is retired
WO_ASSET_RETIRED.body: The job is saved. The office received the review request; go back to Today for now.

WO_ASSIGNED_STALE.title: New job received
WO_ASSIGNED_STALE.body: The job is on this device. Open it to accept or decline when you are ready.

WO_ASSIGNEE_OFF_DUTY.title: Assignee is off duty
WO_ASSIGNEE_OFF_DUTY.body: The job was not lost. Choose someone on duty or confirm the assignment with a warning.

WO_CANCELLED.title: This job was cancelled
WO_CANCELLED.body: Your photos and notes are safe and were sent to the office as evidence.

WO_CHANGED_STALE.title: The job was updated
WO_CHANGED_STALE.body: Your progress is saved. Review the changes before the next step.

WO_CONCURRENT_TECHNICIAN.title: Another assignee is also on this job
WO_CONCURRENT_TECHNICIAN.body: Your work is saved. Go back to Today or continue only with photos and notes when safe.

WO_DECLINE_REASON_REQUIRED.title: Add a reason
WO_DECLINE_REASON_REQUIRED.body: Nothing was sent yet. Choose a quick reason or write a short note.

WO_DESTINATION_MISSING.title: Job location missing
WO_DESTINATION_MISSING.body: The job is saved. Call the customer or ask the office for the location.

WO_PART_NOT_IN_VAN_STOCK.title: Part is not in your van
WO_PART_NOT_IN_VAN_STOCK.body: The job is saved. Use free text, put the job on hold for parts or request a transfer.

WO_REASSIGNED.title: This job went to another assignee
WO_REASSIGNED.body: Your work is saved and the office was notified.

WO_REOPENED_BY_OFFICE.title: Job reopened by the office
WO_REOPENED_BY_OFFICE.body: Your data is saved. See the reason and continue from In progress.

WO_SAFETY_STOP_REQUIRED.title: Stop for safety
WO_SAFETY_STOP_REQUIRED.body: The job is saved. Put it on hold for safety and notify the office.

WO_SIGNATURE_EXCEPTION.title: Signature not completed
WO_SIGNATURE_EXCEPTION.body: The job is saved. Record absence or refusal, add the final photo and complete without a signature.

WO_WAITING_PARTS_HOLD.title: Part unavailable
WO_WAITING_PARTS_HOLD.body: The job is saved. Put it on hold for parts and note what is missing.
